act.speaker: New participant
act.text: Imagine Alpha shows a repeatable convergence pattern because every system receives the same input. The pattern could be real without distinguishing Alpha from a matched shared-input control. I propose control sensitivity for that distinction. Require control sensitivity before treating the pattern B as evidence for the speculative property P.

$control_sensitive.gloss: Its convergence pattern differs from the pattern of a matched control exposed to the same shared inputs.

qualification.explanation: Require a difference from the matched control before treating B as evidence for P.

acknowledgements.note: The condition concerns what evidence B provides. It does not rule out B or decide whether P holds.

history_summary: All eight earlier acts are retained. The new participant introduces control sensitivity to distinguish a repeatable pattern from one explained by shared inputs.
